sourceBook.title: Group Theory: Application to the Physics of Condensed Matter
sourceBook.referenceNote: An original introductory Chinese course reorganized around textbook concepts, not a textbook translation. References give both printed page numbers and physical pages counted from 1 in the user's PDF. Some blank pages are absent, so the offset varies. The PDF copyright page prints electronic ISBN and DOI ending in 8; this site uses the ending 5 verified on Springer's official website. The site does not distribute the book PDF, original figures, or full-page scans.

validation.method: Exact BC source tables are matched row by row to independent numerical regular representations. Checks cover group closure, character orthogonality, the sum of squared dimensions, polar/axial vectors, and symmetric-square decompositions.

methods: Python derives the atlas from the frozen ordinary-space-group operations and verified BC Gamma tables.
All 32 groups checked for orthogonality, matrix closure, conjugacy, character orthogonality, FS indicators and projected function covariance.
Original Chinese lessons have verified textbook chapter/printed-page/PDF-page references.
scope: Ordinary crystallographic point groups and single-valued representations
IR/Raman marks are symmetry allowances, not a prediction of material modes or intensities
The user-provided PDF and page images are not redistributed
